html:
Julfar was a port town near today's Ras al-Khaimah that for several centuries was the main harbour of the coast that is now the UAE.

It lived on pearling, fishing and trade between the Gulf, India and East Africa, and it was tied to the kingdom of Hormuz across the strait. Chinese porcelain found in its ruins shows how far its trade reached. Tradition makes it the home of the navigator Ahmad ibn Majid.

The Portuguese and later the Persians fought over it in the 1500s and 1600s. The town declined, and its people moved to Ras al-Khaimah, the base of the Al Qasimi family, whose fleets later clashed with Britain.
sum: Julfar was a port town near today's Ras al-Khaimah that for several centuries was the main harbour of the coast that is now the UAE.
